MC_SEARCH.description: New MC Search — AW26/PREWINTER articles for New Department Launch (Step MC)
MC_SEARCH.sql:
SELECT
    g.DEPARTMENT,
    g.DISPLAY_TYPE,
    g.ARTICLE_NAME,
    MIN(v.MRP) AS MRP
FROM REPORT.T_GRID g
LEFT JOIN REPORT.V_ITEM_MASTER v
    ON  g.DEPARTMENT   = v.DEPARTMENT
    AND g.DISPLAY_TYPE = v.DISPLAY_TYPE
    AND g.ARTICLE_NAME = v.ARTICLE_NAME
    AND v.ATTRIBUTE1   IN ('LT WINTER', 'PREWINTER','HVY WINTER')
WHERE g.ATTRIBUTE1 IN ('LT WINTER', 'PREWINTER','HVY WINTER')
GROUP BY g.DEPARTMENT, g.DISPLAY_TYPE, g.ARTICLE_NAME
ORDER BY g.DEPARTMENT, g.ARTICLE_NAME

GRC_RAW.description: Main goods receipt — MISRETAIL.CUBE$PURCHASE joined to REPORT.V_ITEM_MASTER
GRC_RAW.sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT TRUNC(ENTRY_DATE,'DD') GRC_DATE,
        SITECODE,
        BARCODE,
        SUM(ENTRY_QTY)  AS GRC_QTY,
        SUM(NETAMT)     AS GRC_NETAMT
    FROM MISRETAIL.CUBE$PURCHASE
    WHERE CUBENAME = 'GRC_ANA'
      AND TRUNC(ENTRY_DATE,'DD') >= TO_DATE(SYSDATE-365)
      AND TRUNC(ENTRY_DATE,'DD') <= TO_DATE(SYSDATE)
      AND BARCODE IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT ICODE
          FROM   REPORT.V_ITEM_MASTER
          WHERE  SUBSTR(SEASON, 1, 4) IN ('AW26', 'SS26')
            AND  DIVISION IN ('KIDS', 'LADIES', 'MENS')
            AND  ATTRIBUTE1 in ('LT WINTER','PREWINTER','HVY WINTER')
      )
    GROUP BY TRUNC(ENTRY_DATE,'DD'),SITECODE, BARCODE
)
SELECT GRC_DATE,
    B.DIVISION,
    B.SECTION,
    B.DEPARTMENT,
    B.DISPLAY_TYPE,
    B.DESC6_FILTER,
    A.BARCODE,
    B.ARTICLE_NAME,
    B.MRP,
    B.SZ_GRP,
    B.ATTRIBUTE1,
    B.COLOR,
    B.CONCEPT_NEW,
    B.DESC3,
    B.CAT1,
    A.SITECODE,
    A.GRC_QTY,
    A.GRC_NETAMT
FROM base A
LEFT JOIN REPORT.V_ITEM_MASTER B ON A.BARCODE = B.ICODE

SALE_RAW.sql:
WITH T_BASE_SL AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM MISRETAIL.T_CUSTOM_COGS
    WHERE {sale_date_filter}
      AND BARCODE IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT ICODE
          FROM   REPORT.V_ITEM_MASTER
          WHERE  SUBSTR(SEASON, 1, 4) IN ('AW26', 'SS26')
            AND  DIVISION IN ('KIDS', 'LADIES', 'MENS')
            AND  ATTRIBUTE1 in ('LT WINTER','PREWINTER','HVY WINTER')
      )
),
T_STORE AS (
    SELECT * FROM MISRETAIL.T_STORE_OPENING_DATE
),
T_ITEM_M AS (
    SELECT ICODE, ATTRIBUTE1, DIVISION, SECTION, DISPLAY_TYPE,
           DEPARTMENT, ARTICLE_NAME, MRP, SEASON, TABLE_NO,
           CAT1, CAT2, CAT3, CAT4, CAT5, CAT6,
           DESC1, COLOR, DESC3, DESC4, DESC5, DESC6,
           DESC6_FILTER, STANDARD_RATE, LAST_IN_RATE,
           STOCKINDATE, OPTION_LEVEL, CONCEPT_NEW
    FROM REPORT.V_ITEM_MASTER
),
T_BASE_SALE AS (
    SELECT
        B.STORE_NAME     AS STORE,
        B.CITY_NAME      AS CITY,
        B.STATE,
        B.DISTRICT       AS ZONE,
        B.STORE_TAG,
        B.OPENING_DATE   AS ST_OPN_DT,
        B.CLUSTER_TYPE   AS CL_TY,
        B.STORE_GRADE    AS ST_GRD,
        C.ATTRIBUTE1, C.DIVISION, C.SECTION, C.DISPLAY_TYPE,
        C.DEPARTMENT, C.ARTICLE_NAME, C.MRP, C.SEASON,
        C.TABLE_NO, C.CAT1, C.CAT2, C.CAT3, C.CAT4, C.CAT5, C.CAT6,
        C.DESC1, C.COLOR, C.DESC3, C.DESC4, C.DESC5, C.DESC6,
        C.DESC6_FILTER, C.STANDARD_RATE, C.LAST_IN_RATE,
        C.STOCKINDATE, C.OPTION_LEVEL, C.CONCEPT_NEW,
        A.BARCODE,
        TRUNC(A.BILLDATE, 'MM')  AS BILL_MONTH,
        A.CUSTOM_SL_Q            AS SL_Q,
        A.CUSTOM_SL_V            AS SL_V,
        A.CUSTOM_COGS_V          AS COGS_V,
        A.TAXAMT                 AS TAX_V
    FROM T_BASE_SL A
    LEFT JOIN T_STORE   B ON A.SITECODE = B.SITE_CODE
    LEFT JOIN T_ITEM_M  C ON A.BARCODE  = C.ICODE
)
SELECT
    STORE, CITY, STATE, ZONE, STORE_TAG, ST_OPN_DT, CL_TY, ST_GRD,
    ATTRIBUTE1, DIVISION, SECTION, DISPLAY_TYPE, DEPARTMENT,
    ARTICLE_NAME, MRP, SEASON, TABLE_NO,
    CAT1, CAT2, CAT3, CAT4, CAT5, CAT6,
    DESC1, COLOR, DESC3, DESC4, DESC5, DESC6, DESC6_FILTER,
    STANDARD_RATE, LAST_IN_RATE, STOCKINDATE, OPTION_LEVEL, CONCEPT_NEW,
    BARCODE, BILL_MONTH,
    SUM(SL_Q)   AS SL_Q,
    SUM(SL_V)   AS SL_V,
    SUM(COGS_V) AS COGS_V,
    SUM(TAX_V)  AS TAX_V
FROM T_BASE_SALE
GROUP BY
    STORE, CITY, STATE, ZONE, STORE_TAG, ST_OPN_DT, CL_TY, ST_GRD,
    ATTRIBUTE1, DIVISION, SECTION, DISPLAY_TYPE, DEPARTMENT,
    ARTICLE_NAME, MRP, SEASON, TABLE_NO,
    CAT1, CAT2, CAT3, CAT4, CAT5, CAT6,
    DESC1, COLOR, DESC3, DESC4, DESC5, DESC6, DESC6_FILTER,
    STANDARD_RATE, LAST_IN_RATE, STOCKINDATE, OPTION_LEVEL, CONCEPT_NEW,
    BARCODE, BILL_MONTH

LY_SALE_RAW.sql:
WITH T_BASE_SL AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM MISRETAIL.T_CUSTOM_COGS
    WHERE {ly_sale_date_filter}
      AND BARCODE IN (
          SELECT DISTINCT ICODE
          FROM   REPORT.V_ITEM_MASTER
          WHERE  SUBSTR(SEASON, 1, 4) IN ('AW26', 'SS26')
            AND  DIVISION IN ('KIDS', 'LADIES', 'MENS')
            AND  ATTRIBUTE1 in ('LT WINTER','PREWINTER','HVY WINTER')
      )
),
T_STORE AS (
    SELECT * FROM MISRETAIL.T_STORE_OPENING_DATE
),
T_ITEM_M AS (
    SELECT ICODE, ATTRIBUTE1, DIVISION, SECTION, DISPLAY_TYPE,
           DEPARTMENT, ARTICLE_NAME, MRP, SEASON,
           DESC1, COLOR, CONCEPT_NEW, OPTION_LEVEL
    FROM REPORT.V_ITEM_MASTER
),
T_BASE_SALE AS (
    SELECT
        B.STORE_NAME     AS STORE,
        B.STORE_GRADE    AS ST_GRD,
        C.DEPARTMENT,
        C.DISPLAY_TYPE,
        C.ARTICLE_NAME,
        C.MRP,
        C.CONCEPT_NEW,
        C.COLOR,
        A.BARCODE,
        A.CUSTOM_SL_Q    AS SL_Q
    FROM T_BASE_SL A
    LEFT JOIN T_STORE   B ON A.SITECODE = B.SITE_CODE
    LEFT JOIN T_ITEM_M  C ON A.BARCODE  = C.ICODE
)
SELECT
    STORE, ST_GRD, DEPARTMENT, DISPLAY_TYPE,
    ARTICLE_NAME, MRP, CONCEPT_NEW, COLOR,
    SUM(SL_Q)  AS SL_Q
FROM T_BASE_SALE
WHERE STORE IS NOT NULL
  AND COLOR IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    STORE, ST_GRD, DEPARTMENT, DISPLAY_TYPE,
    ARTICLE_NAME, MRP, CONCEPT_NEW, COLOR
ORDER BY STORE, DEPARTMENT, SL_Q DESC

GRC_SALE_JOIN.description: GRC vs Sale — article-wise received qty vs sold qty with sell-through % (company level)
GRC_SALE_JOIN.sql:
WITH ITEM_BASE AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ICODE, ATTRIBUTE1, DIVISION, SECTION,
           DEPARTMENT, DISPLAY_TYPE, ARTICLE_NAME, MRP, COLOR, CONCEPT_NEW
    FROM REPORT.V_ITEM_MASTER
    WHERE SUBSTR(SEASON,1,4) IN ('AW26','SS26')
      AND DIVISION IN ('KIDS','LADIES','MENS')
      AND ATTRIBUTE1 IN ('LT WINTER','PREWINTER','HVY WINTER')
),
GRC_AGG AS (
    SELECT G.BARCODE,
           SUM(G.ENTRY_QTY) AS GRC_QTY,
           SUM(G.NETAMT)    AS GRC_VALUE
    FROM MISRETAIL.CUBE$PURCHASE G
    WHERE G.CUBENAME = 'GRC_ANA'
      AND {grc_date_filter}
      AND G.BARCODE IN (SELECT ICODE FROM ITEM_BASE)
    GROUP BY G.BARCODE
),
SALE_AGG AS (
    SELECT S.BARCODE,
           SUM(S.CUSTOM_SL_Q) AS SL_QTY,
           SUM(S.CUSTOM_SL_V) AS SL_VALUE
    FROM MISRETAIL.T_CUSTOM_COGS S
    WHERE {sale_date_filter}
      AND S.BARCODE IN (SELECT ICODE FROM ITEM_BASE)
    GROUP BY S.BARCODE
)
SELECT
    I.ATTRIBUTE1,
    I.DIVISION,
    I.SECTION,
    I.DEPARTMENT,
    I.DISPLAY_TYPE,
    I.ARTICLE_NAME,
    I.MRP,
    I.COLOR,
    I.CONCEPT_NEW,
    NVL(G.GRC_QTY,   0)  AS GRC_QTY,
    NVL(G.GRC_VALUE, 0)  AS GRC_VALUE,
    NVL(S.SL_QTY,    0)  AS SL_QTY,
    NVL(S.SL_VALUE,  0)  AS SL_VALUE,
    CASE WHEN NVL(G.GRC_QTY,0) > 0
         THEN ROUND(NVL(S.SL_QTY,0) / G.GRC_QTY * 100, 1)
         ELSE 0
    END AS ST_PCT
FROM ITEM_BASE I
LEFT JOIN GRC_AGG  G ON I.ICODE = G.BARCODE
LEFT JOIN SALE_AGG S ON I.ICODE = S.BARCODE
WHERE NVL(G.GRC_QTY,0) > 0
ORDER BY I.DEPARTMENT, I.ARTICLE_NAME, ST_PCT DESC
